Morning light moves slowly across the empty room before anyone arrives.
Soft rain crosses the garden while birds wait beneath the branches.
Rain taps softly.
The old clock keeps steady time while shadows gather beside the doorway nearby.
Warm bread cools near the window as the first guests walk inside.
Someone opens the curtains.
Quiet conversation drifts through every corner of the welcoming kitchen.
Outside the wind carries fallen leaves along the road beyond the sleeping houses alone tonight.
Clouds cover the hills.
Two friends arrange simple flowers while another person fills the glasses.
Music from the next room settles gently over the waiting tables.
Chairs face the garden doors before supper.
Candles glow beside polished plates.
Fresh herbs scent the room.
The host checks every place before walking back toward kitchen.
Soon every guest will find a seat and share the meal prepared together.
The bell rings.
Laughter follows footsteps through hall toward each other.
Stories move around the table while the evening deepens beyond every bright window nearby tonight.
Night gathers outside quietly.
The plates leave the kitchen as everyone settles into easy conversation.
Old memories return between bites and smiles among friends again.
Nobody watches the clock tonight during the evening.
Long after supper ends the guests remain together beneath the warm lights sharing quiet stories together.
When the last visitor finally leaves, the quiet house holds every shared story until morning returns and sunlight reaches the empty table again.
